day1_intro.speaker: Sione
day1_intro.text: Ey names Sione bro, just popping in for some chips, cheers g!

day2_intro.speaker: Sione
day2_intro.text: Ey cuz, saw that Gumboot Gang kid hanging round earlier. They're getting bold, bro. Watch yourself.

choices.text: Cheers for the heads up, cuz

gang_info.speaker: Sione
gang_info.text: Small time crew but getting hungry, cuz. Boss is proper dodgy. Don't get too deep with them.

day3_intro.speaker: Sione
day3_intro.text: Ey cuz, heard the Gumboots are pushing new product. Fake IDs and that. Police been asking questions too.

trouble_info.speaker: Sione
trouble_info.text: Nah just moving weight for now. But when gangs get comfortable, they get stupid, cuz.

day4_intro.speaker: Sione
day4_intro.text: Ey heard the Gumboots planning something big, cuz. Ram raids maybe. Keep your head down.

raid_info.speaker: Sione
raid_info.text: Word is they're scoping places. You're probably safe if you're moving their product, but who knows with these guys, cuz.

day5_intro.speaker: Sione
day5_intro.text: Things getting tense, cuz. Police all over the Gumboots. Might go down soon.

police_info.speaker: Sione
police_info.text: They'll get some of the young fellas, but the boss? Nah, he's slippery, cuz.

day6_intro.speaker: Sione
day6_intro.text: Ey cuz, big news - police grabbed that Gumboot kid. Boss is proper angry. Watch your back.

boss_info.speaker: Sione
boss_info.text: Yeah and he's dangerous when cornered, cuz. Might come see you himself now.

day7_intro.speaker: Sione
day7_intro.text: Last day cuz. Whatever goes down tonight, you got this. Just be smart about it.

final_end.speaker: Sione
final_end.text: Always looking out for my people, cuz. Sweet as, I appreciate you sole.

end.speaker: Sione
end.text: Sweet as cuz I appreciate you sole.
